discrepancy_root_cause: Prior iterations of benchmark generation wrote new artifacts into data/benchmark/artifacts/ using random UUID token filenames without purging artifacts from preceding generation runs. Because generation was executed 3 times during pipeline development, exactly 812 * 3 = 2,436 files accumulated on disk while the manifest recorded only the 812 records of the latest run.
remediation_actions: Isolated all 1,624 unreferenced orphan files matching prior runs.
Purged all 1,624 orphan files from disk.
Validated 100% (812/812) bit-level SHA-256 and MD5 checksum matches for all active manifest entries.
Confirmed exact 1:1 file-to-manifest record parity (812 files on disk, 812 rows in manifest).
